### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://lacaixafoundation.org/en/doctoral-inphinit-fellowships-faqs
(Frases literales de las preguntas frecuentes oficiales de los programas INPhINIT Incoming y Retaining.)
"these fellowships are for young researchers who do not have more than four years of full-time research experience"
Candidates must be "in the first four years of their research career" at the closing date. Age is not a limit, and candidates must not already hold another doctoral degree. Applicants cannot already be enrolled in a doctoral programme.
Candidates finishing studies outside the EHEA must confirm that "your studies give you access to the doctorate at the destination university."
Incoming: for a Spanish centre, candidates "cannot have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Spain for more than twelve months" in the three years before the application deadline. The same rule applies to Portugal.
Incoming: candidates "may only opt for predoctoral fellowship positions that appear in the call for applications." The host centre must be accredited as a Severo Ochoa Centre of Excellence, a María de Maeztu Unit of Excellence, or a Carlos III Health Research Institute, or, in Portugal, a unit accredited as "excellent" by the Fundação de Ciência e Tecnologia.
Retaining: candidates "must enroll in a PhD programme of a university other than the one where they studied the bachelor's degree." Applicants do not choose a position; they name a doctoral programme of interest.
The fellowships are incompatible with other paid work, grants, or financial aid.

### Documento oficial (copiado por la tarea): https://lacaixafoundation.org/en/doctoral-inphinit-fellowships-incoming-call
"grants 30 fellowships for researchers of any nationality" to pursue a doctorate in a STEM discipline at research centres of excellence in Spain or Portugal.
(Nota de la tarea: los PDF de las bases https://lacaixafoundation.org/documents/d/la-caixa-foundation/doctoral-inphinit-incoming-2027-rules-participation-pdf y https://lacaixafoundation.org/documents/d/la-caixa-foundation/doctoral-inphinit-retaining-2027-rules-participation-pdf no se pudieron descargar desde este entorno: la dotación económica no consta en los textos consultados.)
